newsitem.title: HUNGARY: VEW, Ruhrgas to boost stake in Budapest gas firm.
newsitem.headline: VEW, Ruhrgas to boost stake in Budapest gas firm.

text.p: The consortium of Germany's VEW AG and Ruhrgas AG said on Tuesday that it planned to buy an eight-percent-minus-one-vote stake in Fovarosi Gazmuvek Rt (Fogaz), Budapest's gas supplier.

The Hungarian MTI news agency quoted representatives of the German investors saying VEW and Ruhrgas planned to buy the stake from municipality and add it to the 39 percent stake the consortium bought in December 1995.
Budapest City Council is expected to make a decision on the sale on Thursday.
Each Fogaz share has a face value of 100,000 forints and the price of one share is likely to be $1,030, MTI said, adding that the registered capital of Fogaz was 32 billion forints.
